# Area: firstdrafts

Started by the build lead from this brief (2026-11-13). It is the definition of done.

Josh (Nov 13, by 10:30): every art piece must have at least one image. Goal of this lane: a first generated candidate for every piece that has none yet.
Do: (1) List the pieces (docs/build/art-inventory.csv and docs/build/art-priority.md) and, read-only across ../<lane>/pipeline/art/proof/ and main, find the pieces with no generated image at all (about 34). Write that list to docs/build/areas/firstdrafts-status.md first. (2) For each, write a prompt from the piece's references.json 'what', the art bible and its art-priority row (same style rules the art lanes use), and generate ONE flash draft per piece with tools/assetgen.py batch (up to 4 calls at once; load keys in the same command: set -a; . ~/.umbrella-ella.env; set +a; never print them). assetgen picks Gemini, then OpenRouter, then fal within their caps; 0.50 USD per piece max. Videos are not needed here (stills only). (3) Save each under pipeline/art/proof/firstdrafts/<piece>/ with a provenance row (origin: generated in jam, first draft, not judged), key/clean it as the art lanes do, run sprite_check/art_check where they apply, but no panel. (4) Commit in batches of about 8 pieces, PRECHECK_FAST=1 bash tools/build/lane_precheck.sh firstdrafts --bg until PASS, so the gate lands them; the stand-ins lane imports them into drawn slots. Never touch another lane's worktree, references.json, approvals.json or pass records. End with: pieces generated, pieces still without an image and why, spend per provider.
